notes: 9/9 deterministic checks passed on the first run; no fix pass was needed. Substantive point flagged in the answer: the two admitted documents disagree on which categories may be recognised as indirect participants. Regulations (26 January 2026) Art. 59(6)(a) limits recognition to Art. 59(1) letters a), b), c); the Instructions in force 30 June 2025, footnote 1, cite 'article 6 of the Rules of the Settlement Service' and list a wider set (SGR, stockbrokers, foreign CSDs, CCPs, Art. 106 intermediaries, Poste Italiane, CDP, MEF). The same Instructions also cite 'Article 57(1)' for issuer eligibility where the reviewed Regulations edition has Article 59(1)(e), which is evidence of stale cross-referencing; this was labelled Reasoned inference and the reconciliation was left as an Unresolved requirement plus Open item, since neither the referenced article 6 nor any reconciling statement is in the bundle. Article 59(5) POA-authorised third parties were distinguished from indirect-participant recognition because the user's phrasing ('one of my clients') could mean either. No clock times, fees, message versions or amounts were asserted; the 4 p.m. urgent-request deadline and the 5-day static-data service level are quoted verbatim from the admitted Instructions excerpt.
